warnings: Bloom rewrites are model-assisted (Claude) and not human-verified; checks are automated.

target_filters: no number absent from the pivot source
no supplied/given/stated reference absent from the pivot source

bloom_exclusions.policy: exclude rows whose gold label is contested (gold_label_contested = true) from training and evaluation
bloom_exclusions.reason: Examples 213 and 570: source labelled Analyze but the task executes a known rule (Apply); awaiting subject-matter-expert decision. See final_corrected_dataset/repaired_v3_20261125/work/challenge_review.json.

qa_source.format: closed_book: system + 'Question:' user turn -> reference_answer (no context passage)

answer_review.method: model-assisted review (Claude): each question and reference answer read in full; arithmetic recomputed for calculation items; factual and conceptual claims checked against standard textbook knowledge. Not a human or subject-expert verification.
answer_review.scope: every row placed in validation or test by the v2 build, plus all calculation/numerical/problem_solving rows from the v1 splits; remaining train rows are not answer-reviewed

qa_source.replaces: SQuAD-style extractive QA used in eduguard_v3_1 (context/answer/answer_start)

summarization_source.format: lecture: system + 'Lecture material:' user turn -> study summary
summarization_source.replaces: all previous summarization rows (no arXiv data is used)

notes: No combined train.jsonl, validation.jsonl, or test.jsonl is persisted.
summarization is the owner-built lecture dataset; bloom_rewrite and qa are unchanged from the base.
